title: How many female customers have a junior credit card?
question: How many female customers have a junior credit card?

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT COUNT(T1.client_id)
FROM client AS T1
INNER JOIN disp_card AS T2 ON T1.client_id = T2.client_id
WHERE T1.gender = 'F'
  AND T2.card_type = 'junior'
